description: Source code for a class that writes build rules for binary targets in a build system, including dependency classification, command line generation, and linking details.

classes.name: NinjaBinaryTargetWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for generating build rules for binary targets, handling dependencies, linking, and command line construction.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main method to generate build rules, delegating to Rust or C binary target writers based on source types.

methods.name: WriteInputsStampOrPhonyAndGetDep
methods.description: Creates a stamp or phony build rule for inputs and returns the dependency file.

methods.name: GetClassifiedDeps
methods.description: Classifies target dependencies into linkable, non-linkable, framework, and swift module dependencies.

methods.name: ClassifyDependency
methods.description: Determines the type of dependency and adds it to the appropriate category.

methods.name: AddSourceSetFiles
methods.description: Adds object files from source sets, including handling of Swift and precompiled headers.

methods.name: WriteCompilerBuildLine
methods.description: Generates a build line for compiling sources with specified tools and dependencies.

methods.name: WriteCustomLinkerFlags
methods.description: Writes linker flags from target and config.

methods.name: WriteLibrarySearchPath
methods.description: Outputs library and framework search paths for the linker.

methods.name: WriteLinkerFlags
methods.description: Outputs linker flags, library paths, and optional def files.

methods.name: WriteLibs
methods.description: Outputs linked libraries, handling source files and library switches.

methods.name: WriteFrameworks
methods.description: Outputs linked frameworks and weak frameworks.

methods.name: WriteSwiftModules
methods.description: Outputs Swift module switches for linking.

methods.name: WritePool
methods.description: Outputs the build pool for the target if set.
